title: Fixing the Renormalization of Inflationary Loops via Ward Identities
summary: Evaluating quantum loop corrections to curvature perturbations in non-attractor inflation presents theoretical ambiguities. A crucial aspect of this challenge lies in the unconstrained finite contributions in renormalization counterterms and regularization scheme dependence. In this work, we derive exact Ward identities via the path integral formalism based on the large gauge symmetry of the background-perturbation split.
